name: smart-compactor
description: Cost & cache panel for Claude Code: cache countdown, cost per turn, ranked cost hints, savings from compacting, and compaction at natural breaks, judged by a model you teach with 👍/👎, with a handoff summary.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: suggest: notify only; auto: compact at a natural break (the judge decides, or the signals when judge is off); off: do nothing

judge.title: Break judge (auto mode)
judge.description: The model that reads each new prompt (context at least minTokens) and decides whether it starts after a natural break; the plugin then compacts before the prompt runs. Rate each compaction with 👍/👎 and the judge learns. off: the signals decide instead

minTokens.title: Minimum context (tokens)
minTokens.description: Only act when the context is at least this large

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: Your main conversation's cache TTL (claude -p hello --output-format json shows ephemeral_1h vs 5m)

openPanel.title: Open the panel at session start
openPanel.description: Opens the Cost & cache panel when a session starts

signals.title: Task-boundary signals
signals.description: git: commit/push/PR; git+deploy: also helm/kubectl/terraform apply; all: also tests, validate, build, finished todo lists. In a replay study no category marked a natural break more often than chance (7-17% vs 14%), so wider sets mostly add compactions mid-task; prefer suggest mode with them
